per_depth.common_affordance: The equality constraints form a connected weighted tree, so the answer is the sum of edges in the unique minimal subtree spanning the critical variables.

per_depth.shortcut_name: Connected N-minus-one graph is a tree
per_depth.common_affordance: The full difference-vector graph is connected and has exactly N-1 edges, so it is a weighted tree; satisfying the target span is therefore exactly connecting all target vertices in that tree.
The shift vectors form the incidence matrix of a connected tree, so satisfying all critical pair differences is exactly the problem of selecting the unique critical-vertex spanning subtree.
